Louis Daily Work Report
Date: 2026.8.18
Location: India Chandigarh 
System/Platform Served:
GDC community (India Market)

Community Leader:
Sanjeev & Natin

Number of Invited Participants: 10
New Sales Performance:- (Philippines)
AiaxChat Downloads: -

Work Activities:
- today meet leaders in India Chandigarh with frank further discuss and follow up with the market
- since this market are mostly from Cdao and has affect quite a lot by Cdao mechanism changed, so today most of the time they had lodge out a lot request, how to ensure safety if full force in doing X-Dao, and the feedback and request wrote as below

Market Feedback Issues:
Proposal from leader in India Chandigarh

For decide whether full force develope team in X-Dao 

1.Due to Cdao mechanism issues that recently changed, requests Cdao representatives or GDC representatives to explain and give the acceptable reasons or solutions to their communities

2.requests an assurance from GDC community that assure X-Dao will not happen the same things.
    A) assure similar mechanism changes would not be introduced by X-Dao in the future.
    B) assure if any mechanism changes needs to have appropriate discuss with indian leaders, or get informed at least by earlier, not to be simply changed and without informed
    C) In case any future changes, needs to be given adequate information and time for market digest the changes

3.Operational fund
Request marketing support should tie with sales has the meal, transport marketing support...

4.Request for more premium or attractive location to held event, in order to closing more high standard leaders

5.Co-governace marketing support funds at least 10k $, for have a more transparency support, and make sure X-Dao financing support won't simply stop without reasonable reason, target sales can be set as 20x (200k)

Others request

1.More professional online training for community consultant, especially how to demonstrate safety security, stability and longevity of the project by on-chain contract coding analysis in detail (need more in-depth technical education) especially a detail comparisons of Cdao and Xdao

2. 5 to 10 tickets for attend the X-Dao Global Launch Event

Summary:
Ivy League meeting was held yesterday. All attendees had previously participated in Olympus DAO and had experienced losses. Most compared the project to CDao. Currently, the sentiment here is relatively conservative, and performance/progress is expected to be slow. Follow-up efforts will be needed.

Upcoming schedule:
23th Aug India Delhi Ivy
26th Aug India Pune Ivy
29th Aug India Delhi Ivy
